title: How To Start a Mobile Detailing Business with $500 (Everything You Need To Know)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: Picks up a lot of dirt. It's dirty really quick.
stated_problem.speaker: Joel Cruz

idea.name: Mobile car detailing (F Cruz / Clean Cruise)
idea.one_liner: A mobile car-cleaning service for vehicle owners, earning money from individual detailing jobs and repeat monthly cleans.
idea.customer: Private vehicle owners, with a stated focus on exotic and other high-end cars; he also serves other cars, trucks and SUVs.
idea.offer: On-site interior and exterior car cleaning and detailing.
idea.revenue_model: Per-job service fees, including monthly repeat cleans; customer leads also come through a paid marketplace.

acquisition_channels.details: He left business cards on cars at high-end malls, then later handed out better cards.
He describes word of mouth from friends and family, then referrals from clients and their friends.
He listed the service on Thumbtac and paid for leads.

ideas.delivery: The operator travels to customers' vehicles and cleans them on site using detailing equipment. He currently works the jobs himself and says reaching his monthly goal would require hiring people.

prices: $30 estimated customer acquisition cost from host
two to 300 as host's comparison quote

ideas.other_uk_rules: For a UK version, UK GDPR may apply to customer contact details and identifiable vehicle photos; provide clear consumer pricing and service terms. Monthly appointments are not necessarily a subscription, but subscription rules under the DMCC Act may be relevant if sold as one. Employment Agencies Regs 2003 may apply if staff are supplied through an agency.
